name: Rufus bootable USB writer
description: Official Rufus utility for creating bootable USB media from supported Windows, Linux and UEFI ISO images on a Windows working computer. It is not a universal phone/tablet recovery tool.
license_note: Rufus is free and open source. Download only from the official Rufus site or its linked official release source.

tutorials.title: Rufus official usage and supported ISO guide
tutorials.scope: Official overview of creating bootable USB media from supported ISO images.
notes: The selected USB is formatted and its data may be erased.
Verify the OS image and confirm the exact USB model and capacity before starting.
Windows-only USB writer; run on a separate working Windows PC.
Select the USB by physical drive identity and capacity; do not select the system disk.
Creating boot media erases the selected USB in common workflows.
A Windows ISO may require Rufus-specific options; use Microsoft's Media Creation Tool when appropriate.
Do not use Rufus to flash Android firmware or arbitrary device firmware.
